title: initramfs-tools-boot provides a init-top script that invokes `modprobe --syslog <module>` in the initramfs.
description:
initramfs-tools-boot provides a init-top script that invokes `modprobe --syslog <module>` in the initramfs.

Unfortunately, the implementation of `modprobe` from `busybox` (which is the one used today) does not support the `--syslog` option.

This results in the dm-multipath module (and its dependencies) failing to load in the initramfs.

The equivalent short option (i.e., -s) is compatible with both implementations so let's use it instead.

```
Begin: Loading multipath modules ... modprobe: unrecognized option '--syslog'
BusyBox v1.38.0 (Ubuntu 1:1.38.0-3ubuntu1) multi-call binary.

Usage: modprobe [-alrqvsDb] MODULE [SYMBOL=VALUE]...

 -a Load multiple MODULEs
 -l List (MODULE is a pattern)
 -r Remove MODULE (stacks) or do autoclean
 -q Quiet
 -v Verbose
 -s Log to syslog
 -D Show dependencies
 -b Apply blacklist to module names too
Failure: failed to load module dm-multipath.
done.
```
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 81fea27..e220fc8 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+multipath-tools (0.14.3-3ubuntu2) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Pass the -s option instead of --syslog when invoking modprobe. The
+    long option is not compatible with busybox's implementation of modprobe
+    (LP: #2165993).
+
+ -- Olivier Gayot <olivier.gayot@canonical.com>  Mon, 07 Sep 2026 18:14:02 +0200
+
 multipath-tools (0.14.3-3ubuntu1) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * Merge with Debian unstable (LP: #2153215). Remaining changes:
diff --git a/debian/initramfs/scripts/init-top/multipath b/debian/initramfs/scripts/init-top/multipath
index 4965e2b..bd0f0bd 100755
--- a/debian/initramfs/scripts/init-top/multipath
+++ b/debian/initramfs/scripts/init-top/multipath
@@ -32,7 +32,7 @@ MP_MODULES="dm-multipath"
 
 verbose && log_begin_msg "Loading multipath modules"
 for module in ${MP_MODULES}; do
-	if modprobe --syslog "$module"; then
+	if modprobe -s "$module"; then
 		verbose && log_success_msg "loaded module ${module}."
 	else
 		log_failure_msg "failed to load module ${module}."
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ verbose && log_end_msg
 
 verbose && log_begin_msg "Loading multipath hardware handlers"
 for module in ${HW_HANDLERS}; do
-	if modprobe --syslog "$module"; then
+	if modprobe -s "$module"; then
 		verbose && log_success_msg "loaded module ${module}."
 	else
 		log_failure_msg "failed to load module ${module}."
